subject: planner: Use/force to apply prefer range scan (#56928)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent focusing on planner+sessionctx changes. Main behavior change is adding an index-hint-derived `StmtCtx.indexForce` flag (set during datasource stats derivation) to apply an additional full table-scan cost penalty, plus refining skyline pruning’s prefer-range logic (incl. index-merge cases) and extracting penalty logic into `getTableScanPenalty` with an important guard to avoid penalizing runtime-decided range scans (`rangeInfo`-based). No Blocker/High correctness/semantics/transaction/session/privilege/protocol issues found in this commit.
